I work at the intersection of fieldwork research and data analysis, turning real-world data into clear, practical insights. My work focuses on animal science, farm management and applied agricultural research. With a background in sustainable cattle production systems, I bring the day-to-day reality of farms into the analysis I do.

## Education

```{r}
#| echo: false
edu <- function(degree, school, years) {
  div(class = "edu-box",
      h3(degree),
      p(em(school)),
      p(style = "text-align: right;", years))
}

div(class = "edu-grid",
  edu("PhD in Agricultural Sciences", "Lincoln University, New Zealand", "2026–present"),
  edu("MSc in Animal Science", "São Paulo State University (UNESP)", "2023–2025"),
  edu("BSc in Agriculture", "Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC)", "2017–2022")
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
job <- function(years, role, org, bullets) {
  div(class = "carousel-item",
      h3(years),
      h4(role),
      p(org),
      tags$ul(lapply(bullets, tags$li)))
}

div(class = "timeline-container",
  div(class = "carousel-nav",
    tags$button(class = "carousel-arrow left", HTML("&larr;"), onclick = "moveCarousel(-1)", `aria-label` = "Previous"),
    tags$button(class = "carousel-arrow right", HTML("&rarr;"), onclick = "moveCarousel(1)", `aria-label` = "Next")
  ),
  job("2025–2026", "Research Assistant", "Independent · Vancouver, Canada",
      c("Data analysis and research support for academic and scientific projects",
        "Co-author of a data descriptor on U.S. forensic DNA databases (Scientific Data, 2026)",
        "Managed several concurrent mini-projects, delivering analysis on time")),
  job("2025", "Research Technician", "FAPESP · Botucatu, Brazil",
      c("Trained and supervised teams on experimental procedures",
        "Statistical analysis planning: experimental design, interpretation and validation",
        "Detailed technical reports on methods, results and conclusions")),
  job("2024", "Visiting Research Student", "University of British Columbia · Agassiz, Canada",
      c("Emerging Leaders in the Americas Program (EduCanada)",
        "Animal welfare research collaboration")),
  job("2023–2024", "Graduate Research Assistant", "Embrapa · São Carlos, Brazil",
      c("Conducted experiments with dairy calves",
        "Managed dairy calf management protocols")),
  job("2023–2025", "Graduate Research Assistant", "São Paulo State University (UNESP) · Botucatu, Brazil",
      c("Coordinated collaborative dairy cattle welfare research with UNESP and Embrapa",
        "Managed team scheduling, meetings and project execution",
        "Organised conferences, workshops and science communication events",
        "Contributed to technical reports, new technologies and patent applications")),
  job("2023", "Teaching Assistant", "São Paulo State University (UNESP)",
      c("Assisted the 'Dairy Cattle' course for veterinary medicine students")),
  job("2022", "Farm Trainee", "Estância Santa Bárbara · Magallanes, Chile",
      c("Daily operations of an 11,000-sheep farm: selection, reproduction, health, shearing and pasture management",
        "Followed the marketing of wool and meat products")),
  job("2019–2022", "Research & Extension Intern", "Federal University of Santa Catarina (LETA and PRV Lab)",
      c("Extension project promoting Voisin Rational Grazing as a sustainable technology for ruminant production (2020–2022)",
        "Designing better water troughs: herd, water temperature and luminosity (2021–2022)",
        "Social hierarchy and personality in cattle access to limited resources (2020–2021)",
        "Social hierarchy, proximity of calving and nociceptive thermal threshold in pregnant cows (2019–2020)")),
  job("2018", "Teaching Assistant", "Federal University of Santa Catarina",
      c("Supported the 'Physics for Agricultural Sciences' course")),
  job("2017–2018", "Search Engine Evaluator", "Lionbridge",
      c("Improved search algorithm quality")),
  tags$script(HTML('
    let currentItem = 0;
    const items = document.querySelectorAll(".carousel-item");

    function showItem(index) {
      items.forEach((item, i) => item.classList.toggle("active", i === index));
      const arrows = document.querySelectorAll(".carousel-arrow");
      arrows[0].style.visibility = index > 0 ? "visible" : "hidden";
      arrows[1].style.visibility = index < items.length - 1 ? "visible" : "hidden";
    }

    function moveCarousel(step) {
      const newIndex = currentItem + step;
      if (newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < items.length) {
        currentItem = newIndex;
        showItem(currentItem);
      }
    }

    showItem(0);

    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") moveCarousel(-1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") moveCarousel(1);
    });
  '))
)
```

## Publications

```{r}
#| echo: false
pub <- function(text, doi) {
  tags$li(HTML(text), " ",
          a(paste0("doi:", doi), href = paste0("https://doi.org/", doi), target = "_blank", rel = "noopener"))
}

div(class = "cert-box",
  tags$ul(
    pub("Pryor Y, Ranka V, <strong>Donadio JP</strong>, Muller SC, Wilson J, Lasisi T (2026). National and state-level datasets of United States forensic DNA databases 2001–2025. <em>Scientific Data</em>, 13, 1322.",
        "10.1038/s41597-026-07605-5"),
    pub("<strong>Donadio JP</strong>, De-Sousa KT, Alves TC, Hötzel MJ, Deniz M (2025). The use of nipple water trough for group-housed dairy calves reduces cross-sucking. <em>Applied Animal Behaviour Science</em>, 289, 106684.",
        "10.1016/j.applanim.2025.106684"),
    pub("<strong>Donadio JP</strong>, De-Sousa KT, Torres RNS, Alves TC, Hötzel MJ, Deniz M (2025). A meta-analysis approach to evaluate the effects of early group housing on calf performance, health, and behavior during the preweaning period. <em>Journal of Dairy Science</em>, 108, 954–967.",
        "10.3168/jds.2024-25159")
  ),
  p(a("More about each paper →", href = "publications.qmd"))
)
```

## Languages

```{r}
#| echo: false
languages <- data.frame(
  language = c("Portuguese (native)", "English (full professional)", "Spanish (full professional)"),
  proficiency = c(100, 90, 90)
)

div(class = "languages-container",
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(languages)), function(i) {
    div(class = "language-item",
      div(class = "language-header",
        span(class = "language-name", languages$language[i])),
      div(class = "language-bar-container",
        div(class = "language-bar",
            style = paste0("width: ", languages$proficiency[i], "%;"),
            `data-proficiency` = languages$proficiency[i])))
  })
)
```
